name: Aldmere Hardpoint
description: Hardpoint game mode for the Aldmere Works map. Five zones go live in turn for 70 s each, marked by a wall of light (white free, blue Agatha, red Mason, purple contested). A team scores 1 point per second while only its players hold the live zone; first to 220 wins. Everyone in the match needs it. It stays idle on other maps.
